title: Independent reading: John 6:60–71
subtitle: Read response, question, and confession after difficult discourse.
overview: This scene records different responses to Jesus’ teaching: complaint, question, departure, and confession. Identify each group and each direct-speech boundary.
The final questions are rhetorically shaped; their force emerges from the preceding narrative response.

items.grc: κύριε, πρὸς τίνα ἀπελευσόμεθα; ῥήματα ζωῆς αἰωνίου ἔχεις.
items.en: Lord, to whom shall we go? You have words of eternal life.

items.grc: καὶ ἡμεῖς πεπιστεύκαμεν καὶ ἐγνώκαμεν ὅτι σὺ εἶ ὁ ἅγιος τοῦ θεοῦ.
items.en: And we have believed and have come to know that you are the Holy One of God.
